items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of influent flow equalization to control seasonal surges, preliminary treatment, a conventional activated sludge process, lime addition equipment to increase alkalinity for ammonia removal, two bioreactors for biological nutrient removal (nitrification/denitrification), membrane filtration, and an ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection system.
